question: What separate full-covariance DESI DR2 Gaussian compression score is obtained from the same explicit retained CLASS LCDM background and predicted drag horizon for the anchor, changed precision and two fixed spectral-index points?

origin.description: External full-LCDM fixed-parameter reference and released DESI Gaussian compression consumer; a native-development reference, not a Prospector reproduction or combined-probe inference target.

assumptions: CLASS v3.3.0 source example parameters are explicit; its source point was conditioned on a joint Planck primary-plus-lensing result and is not a primary-only best fit or independent posterior draw.
The released 13 coordinates retain their exact order and full 169-element covariance, including the final DH-before-DM pair.
DM uses the flat CLASS radial comoving distance, DH is the inverse emitted H/c in 1/Mpc, and DV=(z*DM^2*DH)^(1/3); every ratio uses that same state printed predicted r_drag.
The Gaussian mean is fixed for each retained case; no free fit, diagonalization, covariance jitter or supplied-drag substitution is made.
limitations: Linear interpolation on emitted CLASS background samples and six-decimal printed drag have no earned propagated likelihood-accuracy bound.
The existing native Gaussian estimated-forward-sensitivity gate is empirical and is not a certified end-to-end score error or a physical calibration uncertainty.
Parameter-point ancestry and unknown cross-probe dependence/prior prevent combining this score with the primary CMB or an SN likelihood.

The configured route and its failure-provenance correction have separate committed confirmations recorded in README. Historical C and the independent arithmetic check remain separate parents. Future local source/runtime bindings require review.
No durable archive has yet been created for the ignored full receipts and lawful raw data acquisition routes.

inputs.semantics: 13 ordered DESI DR2 DM/r_drag, DH/r_drag or DV/r_drag compression coordinates; dimensionless values, not raw galaxy data. Fixed release header and axes are checked. Calibration/selection belongs to the release; cross-probe dependence is unresolved.

Full ordered 13 by 13 covariance for the paired dimensionless release means. All cross entries retained; positive diagonal/exact symmetry admitted before the native positive-definiteness and empirical solve screen. No covariance with CMB/SN is supplied.

blockers: End-to-end CLASS interpolation/printed-drag score accuracy and physical/calibration/inference qualification remain unearned.
